- Large perfect HA: real q13 gain, but the official bench flags q18 each time.

## Codebase facts
- Rule registration order: src/optimizer/optimizer.cpp.
- Scan-filter cardinality: RelationStatisticsHelper::InspectTableFilter.
- ColumnData::Filter = Scan + ColumnSegment::FilterSelection (dense-mask and substring prefilter live in column_segment.cpp). The CONJUNCTION_OR FilterSelection has an O(n^2) dedup loop.
- OptionalFilter::FilterSelection returns scan_count (zonemap only). SelectivityOptionalFilter evaluates rows and switches off when not selective. BF is SelectivityOptionalFilter; key-set ranges and IN-list are plain OptionalFilter.
- BF gate: CanUseBloomFilter (physical_hash_join.cpp ~865) needs COMPARE_EQUAL, build_side_has_filter, probe est > ht count, not perfect HT. build_side_has_filter is set in join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp ~331; for a DELIM_GET RHS it tests children[0] (the probe!).
- Exact BF: TrySetExactBloomFilter, EXACT_BF_MAX_BITS_PER_KEY=128.
- Perfect HJ gates: perfect_hash_join_executor.cpp CanDoPerfectHashJoin. Perfect HA: plan_aggregate.cpp.
- Distinct agg: physical_hash_aggregate.cpp distinct_data->radix_tables.
- Semi estimate: cardinality_estimator.cpp SEMI case.
- Noise: q04/q08/q17 ±5-15%, sometimes ±30%; thresholds q16 ~7.9%, q18 ~5%, q13 ~14%, q09 ~8.6%, q14 ~5.1%. Implementer-measured gains are often 2x the official ones. The first run in a dbe-tool sql process is cold (~2x); discard it.
- Testing BF: compare against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown'.

issues.title: Rerun: BF for hash joins whose build side is a DELIM_GET
issues.hypothesis: E0015 was retired only because q14 read +8.0% (12 ms) against a 5.1% threshold. q14 (lineitem JOIN part, no subquery) has no DELIM join, so its plan cannot change under this one-line fix. That regression is bench noise; the implementer reported ±30% swings on untouched templates in that session. The real effect is consistent: q22's decorrelated NOT EXISTS orders scan drops from 15M to 1.9M rows via o_custkey IN BF(c_custkey), giving -19..-27% over four runs (q22 is 180ms, 4.8% of total), visible geomean -1.4%, hidden validation ok. Root cause: join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp (~line 331) sets build_side_has_filter with IsFiltering(join.children[0]), which tests the probe side, so a DELIM_GET build never enables a BF.
issues.plan: Reapply the E0015 diff unchanged. In src/optimizer/join_filter_pushdown_optimizer.cpp, where build_side_has_filter is computed, set it to true when the build child (children[1]) is a LOGICAL_DELIM_GET. Leave the existing IsFiltering logic in place otherwise. The runtime gates in CanUseBloomFilter (COMPARE_EQUAL, not perfect HT, probe est > ht count) and the SelectivityOptionalFilter auto-disable stay as they are. Check q22 results against SET disabled_optimizers='join_filter_pushdown'. Before reporting, run the bench at least twice and include a q14 EXPLAIN that shows its plan has no BF change.
issues.expected_gain: q22 -20%; visible geomean about -1.4%. Other templates unchanged.
issues.generality: Any correlated EXISTS/NOT EXISTS/IN/scalar subquery that gets decorrelated into a DELIM join, where the DELIM_GET distinct key set is much smaller than the probe table (very common in TPC-DS/TPC-H style queries). Worst case: a BF that isn't selective, which the selectivity filter switches off after sampling.
issues.risk: Low. One-line change that was already validated (results correct, hidden validation ok). The only risk is that bench noise flags it again.
